svg.title: Ailin.cz — Multi-tenant AI accounting on top of Abra Flexi: invoicing, cashflow, CRM, projects and a built-in mail client. Vision-LLM document extraction (ISDOC-aware), automatic payment matching, workflow rules and export to Flexi, with guard hooks that keep production accounting data safe. Architected by me, implemented by AI agents.
